entities.summary: Sohrab Pournazeri (b. 1982, Kermanshah) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kermanshah and Iran. Known in the fields of iran, composers & musicians, asia.
